home.title: Train Your Heart With Artificial Gravity
home.description: AnHeart uses centrifugal force to simulate gravity up to 3x Earth's gravity, providing personalized cardiovascular training for athletes and medical rehabilitation.
home.basedIn: Born in Paris, Built for the World

solution.title: Physical Explanation
solution.description: Understanding how centrifugal force transforms cardiovascular training through our innovative rotating platform technology.
solution.step1Description: Due to the rotation, the centrifugal force drives water towards the extremities. The same principle applies to blood flow in the human body.
solution.step2Description: The AnHeart machine directs blood to the lower extremities through rotation, effectively simulating increased gravitational effects on the cardiovascular system.
solution.step3Description: The heart functions as a pump, working against AnHeart's artificial gravity, providing effective and controlled cardiovascular training.

heartRate.title: Controlled Heart Training
heartRate.description: The heartbeat is directly linked to the speed of rotation, allowing precise control of training intensity.
heartRate.lyingDownDesc: The heart doesn't have to contend with gravity
heartRate.standingUpDesc: The heart works against gravity to deliver blood to the brain
heartRate.trainingDesc: The heart functions as a pump against artificial gravity

technology.title: How It Works
technology.description: AnHeart machine uses centrifugal force to simulate gravity, pushing blood flow to the lower body for effective cardiovascular training.
technology.step1Description: Thanks to the rotation, the blood flow is pushed to the lower body, creating artificial gravity effects up to 3x Earth's gravity.
technology.step2Description: The heartbeat is directly linked to the speed of rotation, allowing precise control of training intensity from 40 to 160 BPM.
technology.step3Description: ECG monitoring tracks heart performance in real-time, ensuring safe and effective training sessions with immediate feedback.
